name: fiscaldoo-documentation
description: Centro de documentação do fiscaldoo (docs.fiscaldoo.pt) — esqueleto, não publicado.

scripts.check: npm run check-duplicates && npm run check-coverage && npm run check-architecture && npm run check-troubleshooting && npm run check-campos-cc && npm run check-perfis && npm run check-nif -- --estrito && npm run build && npm run validate-links && npm run check-info-icons && npm run check-notas-internas && node scripts/servir.mjs npm run check-marca
scripts.check-brand: curl -sSf https://www.fiscaldoo.pt/assets/core.css | cmp - src/css/core.css && echo "core.css igual ao do site"
scripts.gates: npm run check && node scripts/servir.mjs "npm run check-video && npm run check-capturas && npm run check-search && npm run check-a11y" && npm run check-brand
